{"title": "[VIGIL] Command Center Guide & Regulatory Playbook", "type": "markdown", "params": {"markdown": "### 🛡️ [VIGIL] Executive CISO & Tier-1 SOC Command Center — Operational Guide
**Objective**: Real-time financial exposure & regulatory compliance monitoring across Indian banking channels (UPI, IMPS, ATM, CBS).

* **₹ Total Rupee Exposure**: Quantifies aggregate transactional funds at risk across impacted Corporate and HNI accounts.
* **High-Risk AML Alerts**: Incident count with AML risk scores > 85 (indicates automated mule account liquidation).
* **Customer Segment Breakdown**: Exposure ratio between high-value Corporate vs Private Wealth (HNI) accounts.
* **Compromise Vectors**: Visualizes which channels (UPI Gateway, ATM Switch, NetBanking) are under active compromise.
* **Regulatory Action**: Incidents exceeding materiality thresholds mandate statutory notification to CERT-In within **6 Hours** under IT Act Sec 70B.
", "fontSize": 10}}
attributes.description: Explains metrics and regulatory workflow for CISO command center

attributes.visState:
{"title": "[VIGIL] Threat Hunting Guide & Triage Procedures", "type": "markdown", "params": {"markdown": "### 🔍 [VIGIL] Threat Hunting & Identity Forensics Lab — Operational Guide
**Objective**: In-depth forensic analysis of authentication anomalies, credential stuffing waves, and lateral movement.

* **Auth Failure Bursts**: Detects rapid spikes in failed authentication attempts across edge API gateways.
* **Attacker Source IPs**: Identifies top origin IPs initiating brute-force bursts and unauthorized transactions.
* **Real-Time Forensic Table**: Correlates threat IPs with compromised accounts, channels, and attempted drain values.
* **MITRE ATT&CK Classification**: Maps threats to Credential Access (TA0006), Lateral Movement (TA0008), and Exfiltration (TA0010).
", "fontSize": 10}}
attributes.description: Explains threat hunting metrics and auth logs

attributes.title: [VIGIL] ATM Switch & CBS Risk Monitor Guide
attributes.visState:
{"title": "[VIGIL] ATM Switch & CBS Risk Monitor Guide", "type": "markdown", "params": {"markdown": "### 🏧 [VIGIL] ATM Switch & CBS Core Banking Risk Monitor — Operational Guide
**Objective**: Specialized monitoring for ISO 8583 protocol drift, unauthorized cash limits, and loan disbursal tampering.

* **ATM Switch Unauthorized Overrides**: Flags rogue modifications raising per-card withdrawal limits above policy ceilings.
* **Payment Velocity Drift**: Detects batch transactions executed outside standard maintenance windows.
* **Containment Protocol**: Null-route attacker switch tap to sinkhole VLAN and rotate HSM MAC encryption keys immediately.
", "fontSize": 10}}
attributes.description: Explains ATM switch drift and CBS loan security
